Maya (People Ops): quick Q — Alex is planning a 6-week hub swap: SF -> DEN for family care, dates Jun 3–Jul 14. He won't change payroll but will be physically located in DEN during the week. Does this affect WFH stipend proration, payroll withholding, or benefits eligibility? Need to advise him today.

Alex (Eng): Yep that's the plan. I'll be in Denver weekdays, back in SF weekends. Not changing payroll for now. cc @Priya (Payroll)

Priya (Payroll): If payroll stays SF home_base then CA withholding continues. However: physical presence in CO >30 days can create CO withholding obligations and potential tax nexus signals. For a 6-week temporary stay we treat it as "temporary location" but we need a few things from Alex:
- fill the temporary home_base form: https://redwood.internal/hr/home_base_temp
- travel dates and primary weekday address in DEN
- confirmation that payroll stays SF (if you want us to switch payroll, that is a different request)

Sample block to paste into the form:
```
start_date: 2026-06-03
end_date: 2026-07-14
primary_weekday_address: 1234 Wazee St, Denver, CO
payroll_change: no
reason: family care
```

Jordan (Finance): Quick note on stipend & benefits: our WFH allowance is tied to declared home_base and is prorated by calendar month when a home_base change is processed. Temporary location entries do NOT automatically move stipend. For a 6-week swap that spans parts of two months we'll calculate prorated amounts if Alex requests a stipend allocation to DEN for those specific dates. Benefits (medical/dental eligibility) usually remain with your original home_base for short temporary moves, but mailing address updates can affect physical card deliveries.

Maya (People Ops): Policy reminder: temporary location = record in HR so payroll/tax can track, but doesn't flip your official home_base unless you submit the full home_base change request. Steps I'm proposing:
1) Alex fills the temporary location form (link above) and attaches itinerary / lodging.
2) Priya confirms withholding obligations with tax ops and flags if CO wants any withholding now.
3) Jordan runs the stipend pro-rata calc and confirms if Redwood will allocate a short-term stipend reclass for those dates.
4) I (People Ops) will update the travel note in your file and confirm benefits continuity.

hr-bot: Please remember to complete required forms within 3 business days to avoid delays to payroll tax processing. https://redwood.internal/hr/home_base_temp :robot_face: 

Alex (Eng): Thanks — I'll fill the form today and attach the Denver lodging confirmation. Also can we ship my docking station to DEN for the 2 weeks?

Priya (Payroll): Equipment shipping handled by ops; mark as "temporary shipment" so inventory knows to expect return. On taxes: for stays >30 days some states (CO included) can require withholding based on physical presence. For 6 weeks we will:
- log the temp location now so we have a record
- run a withholding check; if CO requires withholding immediately we'll notify you and handle the small adjustment on the next payroll run
If this becomes a recurring pattern (multiple multi-week swaps) we'll discuss setting DEN as home_base.

Jordan (Finance): I'll prepare a quick pro-rata worksheet and DM you, Alex. If you want any stipend moved to DEN for Jun/Jul we'll show the net difference after withholding adjustments. :money_with_wings:

Maya (People Ops): I'll add this scenario to the "temporary location" FAQ (short note about >30-day threshold and stipend behavior) and post link here when done. Action items recap:
- Alex: fill temp form + attach lodging (today)
- Priya: confirm withholding next steps with tax ops (EOD tomorrow)
- Jordan: stipend pro-rata calc (EOD tomorrow)
- Maya: update FAQ and confirm benefits continuity (tomorrow)

Alex (Eng): Got it — filling the form now. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
